title: Characteristics of Harmful Text: Towards Rigorous Benchmarking of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating benchmarks that measure coreference resolution accuracy across gender groups (e.g., Winogender, Winobias), difference in log probability of gendered text completions (Gender & Occ), and QA accuracy/sentiment disparities.

Evaluating benchmarks that measure relative changes in perplexity for specific dialects like African American English (TwitterAAE), and differences in sentiment, BLEU, or Rouge scores when comparing text continuations from dialect-specific prompts (SAE/AAVE Pairs).

Evaluating benchmarks that count violent words or track common completions when models are prompted with specific religious identities (e.g., Muslim Bias), as well as broad QA and sentence completion tasks.
Analyzing the use of pre-trained toxicity classifiers (like the Perspective API) to measure the proportion and severity of toxic language in model continuations (e.g., RealToxicityPrompts, BOLD).

bias_targets.target: Intersecting socio-demographic biases (Age, Disability, Nationality, Sexual Orientation, Socioeconomic Status)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating broad question-answering and completion benchmarks (e.g., BBQ, UnQover, Stereoset, BOLD) that measure dataset-specific bias metrics, the percentage of instances where stereotypes are preferred over anti-stereotypes, and comparative sentiment analysis across multiple protected attributes.
